timing.note: One thread, no camera, no painting, no GIL contention. setVideoFrame is the real method; steps_ms comes from a copy of it with timers.

repeatability.note: tool = the value that SampleWorker gives (after Signal(int)); float_path = the same outlier removal on the float centres (the #43 fix).

scale.note: The line moves 500 px between Zero and Take Sample. In the last row it does not move, but smoothing goes from 50 to 0 after Zero.
